name: 78676 · Wimberley, TX
findings: ZIP 78676 (Wimberley) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78676 (Wimberley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78676 (Wimberley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
